title: Zanei event envelope (per-type versions 1 and 2)
description: The authoritative closed OS-independent envelope shared by every event Zanei records. The existing 13 event types require v1 and content.snapshot requires v2. One event appears per line (NDJSON) in raw outputs (query --format jsonl, record, export) and in the events[] array of the MCP query_events result. This file is the single machine-readable contract for all exposure surfaces; the Rust core's schema types are tested against it. Unknown fields, event types, and type-version pairs are rejected. Adding an event type requires a new minimum v and matching store migration.

field_kind.description: Kind of the focused input field, derived from the accessibility role/subrole. Null when focus is not on a text-like element. Secure text fields are excluded at the collector stage, so no password/secure kind can occur.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held. Sorted, no duplicates.

v.description: Minimum envelope version required to interpret this event type. Existing event types use 1; content.snapshot uses 2.

id.description: Event ID: `evt_` prefix + ULID (Crockford base32). Unique and time-sortable.

ts.description: Wall-clock timestamp, RFC3339 with millisecond precision.

mono_ns.description: Monotonic clock in nanoseconds. Use for reliable ordering even across wall-clock adjustments. Not comparable across daemon restarts.

source.description: Capture backend. v1 (macOS) values: macos.workspace, macos.ax, macos.eventtap, macos.applescript. Future platforms add values without a version bump.

type.description: Closed event taxonomy. Adding an event type requires a new minimum envelope version and matching store migration.

app.description: The application the event originates from. For clipboard.copy with data.origin=unknown, name is Unknown and bundle_id and pid are null because no application attribution is available.

bundle_id.description: macOS bundle identifier (e.g. com.google.Chrome). Null for processes without a bundle.

window.description: Window context, when applicable; null otherwise.

id.description: OS window identifier (CGWindowNumber-derived on macOS); daemon-local, null when unavailable.

element.description: UI element context. Non-null only for ui.* events. Secure text fields (password inputs) never appear here.

value.description: Element value, after redaction. Present only when capture.text_content is enabled and the role is an allowlisted known-safe non-text control; null for free-text, secure, unknown, and unavailable roles, and always null when capture.text_content is disabled.

data.description: Type-specific payload, pinned per type by the allOf conditions below. Empty object when the type carries no extra data.

truncated.description: True when normalize removed at least one URL, title, or text field because its UTF-8 byte length exceeded the documented per-field limit. For content.snapshot this is the core 64 KiB safety valve; it is independent from data.complete, which describes whether the collector completed traversal within its 32 KiB and other collection budgets. This required field is true exactly when redaction.rules contains size_limit.

redaction.description: Record of content transformations applied to this event at capture time. Configured redactors apply to free-text fields only (app.name, window.title, element.title, element.value, data.text, data.url, data.tab_title, window.title.data.prev_title), replacing matches with [REDACTED:<rule>]. The always-on size_limit rule removes oversized fields. These transformations are the second line of defense; the first is not capturing at all (secure fields, incognito, capture-time filters).

applied.description: Whether any redaction rule modified this event.

rules.description: IDs of the transformations that fired: configured privacy rules such as email, credit_card, and token, plus the always-on size_limit safety rule. Empty when applied is false.

data.description: No extra data; context is fully carried by the envelope.

prev_title.description: Previous window title (after redaction). The new title is in the envelope's window.title.

value_len.description: Character count after the change when exposed by Accessibility; null when unavailable. Free-text content never lives in element.value.

text.description: Newly added difference after redaction. Present only when capture.text_content is enabled and a keystroke or paste from the same app and focused-element generation has a value-change notification timestamp no more than 3 seconds after input. Authorization is not consumed on emission: the same non-consuming 3-second window can authorize multiple value-change notifications. Null for deletion, app or generation mismatch, expired or missing authorization, unavailable or secure input, and Chrome Incognito or website-filtered windows. The complete field value is never recorded.

kind.description: text = printable typing (coalesced); shortcut = modifier combo; navigation = arrows/page/home/end/tab; delete = backspace/delete; other = esc/F-keys/media.

count.description: Number of keystrokes coalesced into this event. Shortcuts never coalesce (always 1).

combo.description: Shortcut string like cmd+s. Always recorded for kind=shortcut (a shortcut is an action, not content); null for other kinds.

text.description: Characters produced directly by keystrokes from a keyboard-layout input source (coalesced, after redaction). Only when capture.text_content is enabled, kind=text, Accessibility reports a known non-secure text field, Secure Input is inactive, and the Chrome window is eligible when applicable. Null otherwise.

amount.description: Total scroll delta coalesced into this event.

url.description: Current URL of the active tab (normal windows only), after redaction. Null only when its UTF-8 representation exceeded 4 KiB and truncated is true.

tab_title.description: Title of the active tab, after redaction.

mode.description: Always "normal": incognito windows never produce events, so no other value can occur. Kept in the payload as an auditable trace of that guarantee.

transition.description: navigate = URL changed within the tab; tab_switch = active tab changed; null when indistinguishable.

origin.description: copy_shortcut when a Command-C observation from the same process corresponds to the pasteboard change within 500 ms; unknown otherwise. Unknown origin has an unattributed app envelope and no body.

content_kind.description: Derived from pasteboard types. Always recorded.

size_bytes.description: Payload size. Present only for an attributed copy when content capture is authorized; null otherwise.

text.description: Copied text (after redaction). Present only for origin=copy_shortcut when capture.text_content is enabled, Secure Input is inactive, and the Chrome window is eligible when applicable; null otherwise.

content_kind.description: Derived from pasteboard types. Always recorded.

size_bytes.description: Payload size. Present only when content capture is authorized; null otherwise.

text.description: Pasted text (after redaction). Present only when capture.text_content is enabled, Accessibility reports a known non-secure text field, Secure Input is inactive, and the Chrome window is eligible when applicable; null otherwise.

Visible Accessibility text after configured redaction. The collector limits UTF-8 output to 32 KiB at a character boundary and reports that collection cut-off with complete=false. The core independently nulls text above its 64 KiB safety limit and marks the envelope truncated=true.

chars.description: Character count measured by the collector before redaction. It is unchanged when redaction or the core size safety valve transforms text.

complete.description: True only when traversal completed within the collector's time, node, and 32 KiB byte budgets. This is independent from the envelope truncated flag, which reports the core's 64 KiB safety valve.

trigger.description: The scheduling trigger that caused this snapshot.
